section.content: 一种带有防止静电放电保护电路的半导体集成电路，其中一个箝位件与MIS晶体管相连，以在带电器件模型下防止击穿，一寄生双极晶体管、MOS晶体管或其栅极由比转换门的绝缘膜厚的绝缘膜构成的MIS晶体管可用作箝位件。

A Semiconductor integrated circuit with a protection circuit against electrostatic discharge. A clamping element is connected with MIS transistor to prevent the breakdown under the charged device model. A parasitic bipolar transistor, a MOS transistor or MIS transistor whose gate is composed of an insulating film thicker than that of the transfer gate, can be used as the clamping element.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit that may be damaged by static discharge, and more specifically to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, it is provided with metal-insulator semiconductor (MIS) (MIS) transistor as change-over gate.

Background technology

Generally speaking, when the integrated circuit size becomes very big, people's major concern be the breakdown problem of the semiconductor integrated circuit that causes owing to static discharge.Correspondingly, people use the electrostatic breakdown problem of various models (such as manikin, Charged Device Model and charged packaging model) analysing integrated circuits.This need make integrated circuit can not produce the electrostatic breakdown problem under the situation of every kind of model.Especially, at the situation of Charged Device Model and charged packaging model, need the static of the anti-about 600V of integrated circuit usually.

For preventing static discharge; in Japan Patent 07169962A (1985), disclosed a kind of semiconductor circuit; it externally is connected with protection MOSFET between the grid of terminal and output mos FET, wherein protects the channel length of the channel length of MOSFET more than or equal to output mos FET.

The grid of protection MOSFET connects a suitable voltage source, to disconnect protection MOSFET under normal condition.If an improper high pressure is applied on the protection MOSFET, protection MOSFET is switched on the fracture with the oxide-film that prevents output mos FET.

In Japan Patent 63-181469A (1988), also disclose another kind of protective circuit, wherein protected MOSFET to be set between the grid and source electrode of output mos transistor.This protective circuit can prevent the static fracture of the dielectric film of input mos transistor when surge voltage is imported in the input mos transistor.

Recent high-speed DRAM all is provided with the change-over gate that is made of the MIS transistor between out splice going splice and internal circuit usually; wherein the transistorized grid of MIS links to each other with voltage source and its drain electrode links to each other with internal circuit; its source electrode links to each other with out splice going splice or outside terminal by a register; to be inserted in such as the protection component of diode between input adapter and the ground, can prevent the puncture that causes owing to static discharge thus.

The timing that above-mentioned change-over gate is used to limit the amplitude of external signal and make external signal matches with the timing of internal circuit.

Yet in list of references 1, when the number of answering protected output transistor increased, the number of protection MOSFET also increased.Therefore, have a shortcoming as the traditional circuit that disclosed in the above-mentioned list of references, that is, circuit structure becomes complexity and integrated level can not improve yet.In addition, because circuit structure becomes more complicated, thereby need prevent to protect himself puncture of MOSFET.In list of references 2, himself can puncture protection MOSFET under mal-condition.

In addition, under situation such as the semiconductor integrated circuit that each input adapter is all provided a change-over gate DRAM, at experimental session at Charged Device Model, when the electric charge of charging gradually discharged with plunging, the present inventor found that the transistorized gate insulating film of MIS that is used as change-over gate is easy to breakdown under the situation of static discharge.Even showing by any protection component is inserted in, the fact also can't prevent the generation that punctures between input adapter and the ground.

Summary of the invention

Therefore, an object of the present invention is to provide a kind of protection component, it has very high burning voltage required in the Charging system model experiment.

Another object of the present invention provides a kind of clamping piece, and it can be suppressed to minimum with the reduction of integrated level.

Another object of the present invention provides a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, and its change-over gate with a band protection component is used to prevent the fracture of dielectric film.

According to the present invention, it provides a parasitic bipolar transistor as clamping piece to be used to prevent the puncture of semiconductor integrated circuit.

In addition, according to the present invention, it provides the semiconductor integrated circuit, and it comprises an input adapter; One internal circuit; And be connected protective circuit between described input adapter and the described internal circuit; Wherein said protective circuit comprises the protection component that is connected between described input adapter and the ground, the resistance that links to each other with described input adapter, and one is connected the change-over gate between described resistance and the described internal circuit; And a clamping piece, it links to each other with the source electrode of the grid of described change-over gate and described change-over gate or drain electrode and is used to protect described change-over gate.

According to another aspect of the present invention, it also provides a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, comprises: an input adapter; One internal circuit; One metal insulator semiconductor transistor, its grid links to each other with ground by first resistance, and the source electrode of wherein said metal insulator semiconductor transistor or drain electrode link to each other with described input adapter; One clamping piece, it is connected between described grid and described source electrode or the described drain electrode; Be connected the source electrode of described input adapter and described metal insulator semiconductor transistor or second resistance between the drain electrode; Be connected the source electrode of described internal circuit and described metal insulator semiconduction or the 3rd resistance between the drain electrode; Protection component, it is connected between described internal circuit and the ground.

According to above-mentioned the present invention, can be protected and prevent to puncture as the MIS transistor of the change-over gate that has clamping piece.

Description of drawings

Fig. 1 is the circuit diagram of semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention;

Fig. 2 is another circuit diagram of semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention.

Embodiment

Below with reference to accompanying drawing most preferred embodiment of the present invention is described.

Semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention shown in Fig. 1 comprises input adapter 10 and internal circuit 11.In addition, comprise the transistorized change-over gate 18 of a MIS and be connected between input adapter 10 and the internal circuit 11, here, available out splice going splice replaces input adapter 10.

Particularly, protective circuit 15 comprises the protection component 16 such as diode, register 17 etc., provides voltage Vg by internal source voltage or external voltage source to the grid of MIS transistor 18.

In addition, clamping piece 20 is connected between the source electrode or drain electrode of grid and MIS transistor 18, and clamping piece 20 is adjacent with MIS transistor 18.

Effect to protective circuit when here, supposing not insert clamping piece is described.In the case, in manikin, be provided for electrostatic pressure protected element 16 clamps of input adapter 10.Therefore, can prevent that too high voltage is applied on the internal circuit 11.

In addition, because of the MIS transistor 18 as change-over gate is connected with protection component 16 and internal circuit 11, thereby under normal condition, be restricted from the input signal amplitude of input adapter 10.

In the Charging system model, device is slowly charged, a certain then pin (as input adapter 10) is suddenly discharged, and in above-mentioned slow charging process, the whole nodes shown in Fig. 1 are recharged, then, joint 10 is discharged suddenly, and the discharge of power line simultaneously is delayed, therefore, excessive high pressure is provided to MOS transistor 18, and this will cause the puncture of MOS transistor 18.

The inventor has been found that the reason of puncture is to discharge on the circuit that is connected with MIS transistor 18, and has found a kind of method of puncturing of preventing, as shown in fig. 1, uses the clamping piece 20 that links to each other with the source electrode and the grid of MIS transistor 18 can prevent the puncture of gate insulating film.

Diode, MOSFET and parasitic bipolar transistor all are known clamping piece.For example, the MIS transistor as clamping piece is connected between the grid and transistorized source electrode of MIS or drain electrode of MIS.In other words, link to each other with the input of MIS transistor 18 as the transistorized grid of the MIS of clamping piece, the emitter of parasitic bipolar transistor and collector electrode become the both-end sub-element as the terminal of clamping piece.

An alternative embodiment of the invention shown in Fig. 2 comprise the input corresponding and output (I/O) joint 10 with input adapter 10, with protective circuit 16 corresponding be the P channel MOS transistor 27 in the MOS transistor 26 of diode connected mode and resistance 32, the internal circuit 11 and N-channel MOS transistor 28, and the bipolar transistor 29 that links to each other with the grid and the source electrode of N-channel MOS transistor 28.Bipolar transistor 29 is adjacent with N-channel MOS transistor 28.

I/O joint 10 links to each other with the source electrode of nmos pass transistor 36 and load nmos pass transistor 37, the grid of load nmos pass transistor 37 links to each other with the drain electrode of nmos pass transistor 41, in addition, the source electrode of nmos pass transistor 41 links to each other with nmos pass transistor 37 common junction with nmos pass transistor 36.In addition, the emitter of NPN transistor 42 and collector electrode are connected between the source electrode and grid of nmos pass transistor 41.NPN transistor is a parasitic bipolar transistor, and the effect of NPN transistor 42 is clamping pieces 20 as shown in fig. 1.Nmos pass transistor 41 and NPN transistor 42 link to each other with ground by the 3rd resistance 43.Therefore, circuit function is similar among circuit as shown in Figure 2 and Fig. 1.

As shown in fig. 1, NPN transistor 29 has the function of clamping piece 20 equally.

Though most preferred embodiment of the present invention is described, clear and definite various modifications of being done to those skilled in the art of palpus and variation are all within the scope of the present invention.

For example, MOS or the MIS transistor that has in circuit element than the gate insulating film of other MOS or the transistorized gate insulation thickness of MIS all can be used as the clamping piece that substitutes parasitic bipolar transistor.
